pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-02-27. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-02-27 at 1,780.85 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 9.68 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 2,065 million. The top gainer of the week was Ndege Energy (SYN).

Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Market participants said the move reflected steady demand from retail and institutional investors. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
